[b]
[/b][b]Description[/b]:

This mod changes the game's time format from 24 hours to 12 hours (with AM/PM) in the user interface above the money balance, ideal for those who prefer a more familiar or traditional time display.

[b]Update[/b]: Changes not only the format of the top clock but also all time in dialogue and texts.

[b]Features[/b]:[b]
[/b][list]
[*]Automatically changes the game clock from 24 hours to 12 hours.
[*]No additional configuration or settings required.
[*]Simply place it in the "/Mods" folder and it works instantly.
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and later.

[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]:

[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI installed with the latest update.

[*]Download and unzip the file.

[*]Place the mod folder into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]

[*]Launch the game and enjoy the 12-hour clock format.

[/list][b]Improvements:[/b]
﻿Now supports general translations.

[b]Compatibility:[/b]
﻿Tested on version 1.6.15. Should not cause conflicts with other mods unless they specifically modify the time format.
